verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party way to define automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled or triggered jobs or agents. Headless Sync is a sync client that external automated workflows can use, and Obsidian URI and the plugin API are building blocks for constructing automation. None of these is the automation capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
